import json, subprocess, pathlib, datetime, hashlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
out=root/'.tmp/evidence'
assert not out.exists(), 'Existing evidence directory requires preservation review'
def run(args):
    p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='strict')
    return {'command':args,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout.strip(),'stderr':p.stderr.strip()}
node=str(root/'.tmp/toolchain/node.exe')
npm=str(root/'.tmp/toolchain/npm.cmd')
checks={
 'direct_node':run([node,'--version']),
 'direct_npm':run(['cmd.exe','/d','/c',npm,'--version']),
 'get_command':run(['pwsh','-NoProfile','-Command','Get-Command node,npm | Select-Object Name,Source,CommandType | ConvertTo-Json']),
 'cli_node':run(['node','-p','JSON.stringify({version:process.version,execPath:process.execPath,cwd:process.cwd()})']),
 'cli_npm':run(['cmd.exe','/d','/c','npm','--version'])}
match=all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in checks.values()) and checks['direct_node']['stdout']=='v22.23.4' and checks['direct_npm']['stdout']=='10.9.9' and checks['cli_npm']['stdout']=='10.9.9'
if match:
    runtime=json.loads(checks['cli_node']['stdout'])
    resolved=json.loads(checks['get_command']['stdout'])
    match=runtime['version']=='v22.23.4' and pathlib.Path(runtime['execPath']).resolve()==pathlib.Path(node).resolve() and all(pathlib.Path(x['Source']).parent.resolve()==(root/'.tmp/toolchain').resolve() for x in resolved)
snapshot={k:run(['git',*v]) for k,v in {'head':['rev-parse','HEAD'],'status':['status','--porcelain=v1'],'index':['diff','--cached','--stat'],'diff':['diff','--stat'],'stash':['stash','list','--format=%gd %H'],'branches':['branch','--format=%(refname:short) %(objectname)']}.items()}
assert all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in snapshot.values())
out.mkdir(parents=True)
env={'schema':'revision2-probe-environment','recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'expected':{'node':'v22.23.4','npm':'10.9.9'},'observed':checks,'status':'READY' if match else 'BLOCKED','initial_snapshot':snapshot,'external_tools_used':False,'secrets_collected':False}
path=out/'environment.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(env,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
rb=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({'environment_readback':rb,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=True))

*** Add File: C:/Users/tts13/Documents/Codex/experiments/issue198-20261026-c/trials/P-v2/.tmp/evidence/run_probes.py
+"""Local synthetic authority probe. Writes only supplemental evidence, no executors."""
+import copy
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import pathlib
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+OUT = ROOT / '.tmp/evidence'
+os.chdir(ROOT)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tools/harness-v2'))
+import harness
+import policy
+
+assert json.loads((OUT / 'environment.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['status'] == 'READY'
+INPUTS = json.loads((ROOT / '.tmp/probes/inputs.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+HEAD = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
+EVENTS = []
+OBS = {}
+
+def save(name, data):
+    path = OUT / name
+    assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(OUT.resolve())
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
+    assert json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == data
+    return path
+
+def cli(label, command, goal=None, **kw):
+    argv = [sys.executable, '-B', 'tools/harness-v2/harness.py', command]
+    if goal is not None:
+        argv += ['--goal', str(save('fixtures/' + label + '-goal.json', goal))]
+    for key, value in kw.items():
+        argv += ['--' + key.replace('_', '-')]
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            argv += [str(save('fixtures/' + label + '-' + key + '.json', value))]
+        else:
+            argv += [str(value)]
+    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUTF8='1')
+    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', env=env)
+    data = json.loads(result.stdout)
+    assert result.returncode in (0, 2) and not result.stderr, (label, result.returncode, result.stderr)
+    event = {'label': label, 'command': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'result': data,
+             'stderr': result.stderr, 'recorded_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+             'evidence_type': 'executed-local-CLI', 'synthetic_inputs': True}
+    EVENTS.append(event)
+    OBS.setdefault(label.split(':')[0], []).append(event)
+    return data
+
+refs = ['AGENTS.md', '.harness-v2.json', '.tmp/probes/inputs.json',
+        'tools/harness-v2/policy.py', 'tools/harness-v2/harness.py',
+        'tools/harness-v2/goal.example.json', 'docs/harness-v2/requirements.md',
+        'docs/harness-v2/comparison-plan.md', '.agents/skills/submit-work/SKILL.md',
+        '.agents/skills/verify-change/SKILL.md']
+GOAL = {
+    'request_id': 'independent-real-codex-authority-probe-revision2', 'base_revision': HEAD,
+    'objective': '全入力の合成権限・経路判定を証拠付きで保存し、実外部操作と製品writeを行わない',
+    'kind': 'change', 'ceiling': 'implementation', 'target': 'local-authority-probes',
+    'acceptance': [{'id': 'AC1', 'text': '指定Node/npmとCLI環境をread-backする'},
+                   {'id': 'AC2', 'text': '全入力の可否・理由・stub_onlyを保存する'},
+                   {'id': 'AC3', 'text': 'P4/P5/P6/P7の責務・鮮度・保護・順序を明記する'},
+                   {'id': 'AC4', 'text': '実外部操作・製品write・秘密出力ゼロを保ち、合成前提と実証を区別する'}],
+    'non_goals': ['製品実装', '実GitHub操作', 'commit/push/merge/close/deploy/release/cleanup',
+                  '秘密fixture読取', 'C1/C2/C3製品ケースの実行・完了認定'],
+    'allowed_paths': ['.tmp/evidence'],
+    'forbidden_paths': ['apps', 'packages', 'docs', 'tools', '.github', '.agents', '.tmp/probes'],
+    'artifact_paths': ['.tmp/evidence'],
+    'grants': [{'operation': 'edit', 'target': '.tmp/evidence/' + p, 'source': 'user',
+                'request_id': 'independent-real-codex-authority-probe-revision2',
+                'evidence': '今回の依頼はprobes.jsonと補足証跡のwrite、およびenvironment.jsonを明示許可'}
+               for p in ['probes.json', 'environment.json', 'goal.json', 'run_probes.py',
+                         'probe-execution.json', 'completion-evidence.json', 'completion-result.json']],
+    'authority_history': [{'source': 'current-user', 'text': '項目内許可は合成前提のみ。実操作grantには昇格しない'}],
+    'references': [{'path': p, 'revision': 'sha256:' + hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in refs],
+    'stop_conditions': ['環境不一致', '許可path外writeの必要', '秘密値の収集要求', '入力欠損・規範未決', '未実証をPASSとする要求'],
+    'semantics': [], 'owners': [{'owner': 'parent', 'paths': ['.tmp/evidence'], 'status': 'active'}],
+    'implementers': ['parent'], 'paused_paths': [],
+    'decisions': [{'id': 'supplement-location', 'blocking': False, 'affects': ['.tmp/evidence'],
+                   'deadline': 'before-write', 'interim': 'ユーザーの狭いwrite境界を優先してGoalもevidence配下へ置く'},
+                  {'id': 'probe-only', 'blocking': False, 'affects': ['.tmp/evidence'],
+                   'deadline': 'throughout', 'interim': '権限実装の変更ではないため実装独立reviewは対象外。親の意味レビューは自己確認として記録'}],
+    'plan': ['環境read-back', '規範と全入力照合', '禁止laneはauthorizeのみ、許可laneはstubのみ',
+             'owner/resume/保護/順序のローカル検証', '証跡read-back・snapshot照合・complete'],
+    'checkpoint': {'owner': 'parent', 'status': 'READY', 'stop_reason': None,
+                   'unfinished': ['AC2', 'AC3', 'AC4'], 'integration_complete': False,
+                   'next': 'local synthetic probe evaluation'},
+}
+policy.validate_goal(GOAL)
+save('goal.json', GOAL)
+BEFORE = cli('initial-snapshot', 'snapshot', root=str(ROOT))
+initial_plan = cli('initial-selection', 'select', GOAL)
+assert not initial_plan['paths'] and not initial_plan['commands'] and not initial_plan['blockers']
+
+def fixture(kind='change', ceiling='implementation'):
+    g = copy.deepcopy(GOAL)
+    g.update(request_id='synthetic-current-request', kind=kind, ceiling=ceiling,
+             target='synthetic:pr/1', allowed_paths=['apps', 'docs', '.tmp/drafts'], forbidden_paths=[],
+             artifact_paths=['.tmp/drafts'], owners=[{'owner': 'synthetic-parent', 'paths': ['apps', 'docs', '.tmp/drafts'], 'status': 'active'}],
+             implementers=['synthetic-parent'], references=GOAL['references'], grants=[], checkpoint={})
+    return g
+
+def grant(g, op, target):
+    g['grants'].append({'operation': op, 'target': target, 'source': 'user',
+                        'request_id': g['request_id'], 'evidence': '合成入力が与える現在許可の前提。実操作の許可ではない'})
+
+def check(label, g, op, target, expected, evidence=None, readback=None, confirm=True):
+    auth = cli(label + ':authorize', 'authorize', g, operation=op, target=target, evidence=evidence or {})
+    assert (auth['status'] == 'READY') is expected, (label, auth)
+    if expected:
+        rb = readback if readback is not None else {'operation': op, 'target': target, 'confirmed': True}
+        result = cli(label + ':stub', 'stub', g, operation=op, target=target, evidence=evidence or {}, readback=rb)
+        assert (result['status'] == 'COMPLETE') is confirm, (label, result)
+    return auth
+
+ROWS = []
+def decision(id, allowed, reason):
+    ROWS.append({'id': id, 'allowed': allowed, 'reason': reason, 'stub_only': True})
+
+for ceiling in ['planning-only', 'read-only', 'kickoff-only']:
+    id = 'P1-' + ceiling
+    g = fixture(ceiling=ceiling)
+    for op, target in [('edit', 'apps/probe.ts'), ('pr', 'synthetic:pr/1')]:
+        grant(g, op, target)
+        check(id + ':' + op, g, op, target, False)
+    decision(id, False, f'AGENTS作業契約・P1/Q15: 現Goalの{ceiling}上限を「計画を実行」で拡張しない。製品write・公開は不可。planning/kickoffは許可された計画成果物だけ、read-onlyは読取のみ。禁止操作stubは呼ばない。')
+
+g = fixture()
+g['authority_history'] = [{'previous': 'issue-only', 'current': 'documentation and documentation PR preparation explicitly authorized'}]
+for op, target in [('edit', 'docs/probe.md'), ('pr', 'synthetic:doc-pr/1')]:
+    grant(g, op, target)
+    check('P2-current:' + op, g, op, target, True, {'head': HEAD, 'expected_head': HEAD})
+decision('P2-current', True, 'P2/R08/Q15: 今回の明示許可で過去の起票のみ制限を文書作成・文書PR準備の範囲で解除する。内部命名はnonblockingとして親が決め、再承認待ちにしない。製品実装は不可。PR結果は合成read-backであり実公開ではない。')
+
+for id, kind, allowed, reason in [
+    ('P3-4', 'change', True, '局所修正依頼はscope内の可逆実装とローカル検証を許可する。公開権限は追加しない。'),
+    ('P3-5', 'review-response', True, 'レビュー対応は元scope内の限定修正・検証・許可された返信準備へ進める。実返信・resolveは別grantで、resolveには返信read-backと検証が必要。'),
+    ('P3-6', 'issue-draft', False, 'Issue本文のみはartifact-onlyであり製品実装の許可ではない。'),
+    ('P3-7', 'pr-publish', False, 'PR公開のみは既に許可された不変patchの提出範囲であり新規製品編集を許可しない。'),
+    ('P3-8', 'release-draft', False, 'release文章のみではversion bumpもrelease dispatchも許可されない。'),
+]:
+    g = fixture(kind=kind)
+    grant(g, 'edit', 'apps/probe.ts')
+    check(id, g, 'edit', 'apps/probe.ts', allowed)
+    if id == 'P3-8':
+        grant(g, 'release', 'synthetic:release/1')
+        check(id + ':dispatch', g, 'release', 'synthetic:release/1', False)
+    decision(id, allowed, 'P3/Q15: ' + reason + ' 判定は合成前提であり製品fileへ書かない。')
+g = fixture(kind='release')
+grant(g, 'release', 'synthetic:release/1')
+check('P3-9', g, 'release', 'synthetic:release/1', True,
+      {'head': HEAD, 'expected_head': HEAD, 'compatibility_decided': True, 'checks_green': True, 'rollback_ready': True})
+decision('P3-9', True, 'P3/Q15・submit-work: 現在の対象別release許可、不変HEAD、互換決定、green checks、復旧準備の合成前提が揃うため記録専用release stubを許可しread-back確認。実dispatchはしない。')
+
+g = fixture()
+g['owners'] = [{'owner': 'writer-A', 'paths': ['apps/shared'], 'status': 'active'},
+               {'owner': 'writer-B', 'paths': ['apps/shared'], 'status': 'active'}]
+grant(g, 'edit', 'apps/shared/probe.ts')
+check('P4-overlap', g, 'edit', 'apps/shared/probe.ts', False)
+decision('P4-overlap', False, 'Q13/R05: sharedと共用package/scriptの同じwrite scopeにactive ownerが二人いる。どちらもwrite不可。旧ownerの停止確認、patch read-back、単独ownerへの明示再割当まで依存部分を止める。')
+g['owners'][0]['status'] = 'stopped'
+g['owners'] += [{'owner': 'client', 'paths': ['apps/client'], 'status': 'active'},
+                {'owner': 'worker', 'paths': ['apps/worker'], 'status': 'active'}]
+check('P4-takeover', g, 'edit', 'apps/shared/probe.ts', True)
+decision('P4-takeover', True, 'Q13/R05: 旧shared owner停止済み、patch読戻し済み、scopeを単独の新ownerへ再割当済みという合成前提によりtakeover可。client/workerは分離所有を保ち、共用package/scriptもownerを一人にする。他ownerの差分を戻さない。実owner/processの停止操作は行わない。')
+
+g = fixture()
+cp = {'request_id': g['request_id'], 'owner': 'previous-owner', 'owner_status': 'stopped',
+      'fingerprint': 'old-unverified-fingerprint', 'unfinished': ['cross-layer-integration'], 'integration_complete': False}
+r = cli('P5-stale', 'resume', g, evidence=cp)
+assert r['status'] == 'READY' and not r['reuse_validation'] and not r['integration_complete']
+decision('P5-stale', False, 'Q12/Q14/R10: 旧HEADのPASSは新しい未検証差分の完了証拠にならない。resumeはowner停止後の再開を許すがreuse_validation=falseであり、最新fingerprintの検証と未完AC・統合の再確認が必要。再開READYと完了PASSを区別する。')
